monitoring.persistenceAlert: The gateway keeps data after restart by storing it in shared storage. Where to store is a one-time deployment decision (Redis / built-in database / local files); standalone deployments can ignore this tab
monitoring.templatesAlert: Vendor presets shared by provider selection and the template-based wizard. No daily changes needed
monitoring.categoriesAlert: Override default settings per model category. Defaults from global settings apply when empty
monitoring.adaptersAlert: Chosen automatically when connecting a new vendor; only needed when a vendor API is non-standard
